description: Record that a post finished in the network's app (TikTok inbox uploads, finish-in-app and post-it-yourself posts). Pass the post's link (Share, then Copy link) so insights can follow it. A post-it-yourself target can be marked once approved, even before its time.

idempotency_key.description: Any unique string, e.g. a UUID. A retry with the same key within 24 hours returns the first call's result instead of doing it again.

target_id.description: ID of one network's copy of a post (a UUID): the targets list in post_get

name: target_mark_posted
title: Mark as posted
